'''Melicoste''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served as a loyal agent to [[Darth Baras]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Melicoste was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Around [[3641 BBY]], he was sent by [[Darth Baras]] to free his sister [[Darth Ekkage]] from the [[Belsavis prison]], belonging to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Melicoste commandeered a squad of [[Imperial commando (Sith Empire)|Imperial commandos]] led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Kaid]] and set out to track Ekkage.<ref name="Strong" /> After pinning down Ekkage's location, he sent a detachment of men to free Ekkage's imprisoned [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]], but they were stopped by the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]].<ref name="Mass">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Mass of Assassins|Belsavis}}</ref> Meanwhile, Melicoste made it to [[Cell Block 77-Z]] within [[The Tomb]], where Ekkage was being kept. He freed her, but instead of showing gratitude, Ekkage effortlessly killed Melicoste for his incompetence.<ref name="TTR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The player has the option of letting him leave for light side points or letting Ekkage kill him for dark side points.<ref name="TTR" />
